ambient_events: The drop hammer goes eleven times and stops.
Something comes out of the quench with a noise like a held breath.
A blade is offered up against somebody's grip, taken back, and ground a little more.
description: An open-sided works of salvaged plate where the region's scrap comes to be argued with: a drop hammer, a bank of gas bottles, a bath of quench oil with a skin on it. Everything made here is made to be mended, and you can tell, because half of what is stacked by the door has been mended already.
name: The Foundry
